title: Malformed request
description: The request could not be decoded.

title: Mobile app required
description: This action is only available in the Open AIQ mobile app.

title: Resource not found
description: The requested resource was not found.

title: Method not allowed
description: The request method is not supported for this resource.

title: No readings available
description: The device has not reported any readings.

title: Conflict
description: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.

title: Request content too large
description: The request body exceeds the accepted size.

title: Unsupported media type
description: The request uses an unsupported media type.

title: Too many requests
description: The client sent too many requests; retry later.

title: Request validation failed
description: One or more request values are invalid.

title: Internal server error
description: The server could not complete the request.
